principle: RSP defines the BINDING SHAPE (session/decision/revision/digest + provider-owned selection), never the raw identifier alphabet. Providers keep native ids; the facade aliases coordinates 1:1 and preserves exactly-once + stale/digest rejection on both sides.

rsp_concepts.options_digest: SHA-256 over the canonical sorted option-fingerprint multiset for the parked frame. XMage facade COMPUTES it (native gap); Forge ALIASES legalSetDigest (native equivalent). Verified on every submit; mismatch aborts before mutation.
rsp_concepts.provider_owned_selection: Opaque to Lab. XMage: decision_id:option_id or decision_id:numeric (+ numeric_choice/ordering within bounds). Forge: opt-UUID or free-input value or divided vector. Lab submits bytes it was given; never synthesizes.
rsp_concepts.state_revision: Monotonic per session. XMage: decision_offset. Forge: frameSeq. Strictly increasing; parked-vs-submitted mismatch -> stale rejection, no mutation.
rsp_concepts.session_decision_ids: session_id = game_id alias (both providers). decision_id stable per frame (XMage: hash of game/offset/actor/class; Forge: frameSeq-scoped). Unique per session; never compared across providers.

xmage.option_id: decision_id:option_id (opaque, decision-bound; prefix parsed to bind revision)

forge_ws227.actor: pN stable principal (immutable seat registry; never display names)
forge_ws227.decision_class: forge:<kind-lower>/1 opaque (forge-decision-protocol/1.0.0); unknown Kinds fail closed, no generic fallback
forge_ws227.decision_id: frameSeq-scoped frame identity (revision doubles as coordinate)
forge_ws227.legalSetDigest: SHA256 over sorted optionFingerprint multiset + legalSetSize (== RSP options_digest)
forge_ws227.optionFingerprint: SHA256 over Core-authoritative fields (UUIDs excluded, labels redacted); identical siblings collide -> AMBIGUOUS by design
forge_ws227.selection: opt-UUID | free-input value (native bounds) | divided allocations (Core total/min/upTo)
